notes.title: Progress Chess: Path to Mastery
notes.content:
1.New Time Control Mode with Fischer Clocks: Players will receive a set number of seconds added to their remaining time for each move made.
2.New Tournament Lineup: In addition to standard time-control tournaments, new tournaments for rapid chess (rapid or blitz, depending on the selected speed mode) will be introduced, featuring either Fischer clocks or standard time controls.
3.Improved and reworked characters play strength balance: Ensures a smoother entry into the chess career, even for absolute beginners.
4.Enhanced and balanced Learning Mode: Added simpler tasks for newcomers, zoomable demonstration boards, and improved localization.
5.PGN Export Functionality: Ability to export played games in PGN format directly from the list of saved games.
6.New Voice-Acted chess-player characters: Over a dozen new characters with skill levels ranging from 200 Elo to Grandmaster.
5.Additional locations: several new in-game locations added.
8.Optimized In-Game UI: Interface elements are hidden when the board is zoomed in for a cleaner view.

notes.title: Major Progress Chess update on 15 april.
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the date for the upcoming major update to Progress Chess. The update, titled Progress Chess: Path to Mastery, will become available on April 15 of this year and will include the following additions and improvements:

1.New Time Control Mode with Fischer Clocks: Players will receive a set number of seconds added to their remaining time for each move made.
2.New Tournament Lineup: In addition to standard time-control tournaments, new tournaments for rapid chess (rapid or blitz, depending on the selected speed mode) will be introduced, featuring either Fischer clocks or standard time controls.
3.Improved and reworked characters play strength balance: Ensures a smoother entry into the chess career, even for absolute beginners.
4.Enhanced and balanced Learning Mode: Added simpler tasks for newcomers, zoomable demonstration boards, and improved localization.
5.PGN Export Functionality: Ability to export played games in PGN format directly from the list of saved games.
6.New Voice-Acted chess-player characters: Over a dozen new characters with skill levels ranging from 200 Elo to Grandmaster.
7.Additional locations: several new in-game locations added.
8.Optimized In-Game UI: Interface elements are hidden when the board is zoomed in for a cleaner view.

notes.title: Major Progress Chess update in April.

Dear friends, we have good news for you!

Follow our announcements.

notes.title: Progress Chess: Champions.
notes.content:
1. A new "Champions" section with detailed information about all world champions, from Steinitz to Ding Liren, with a database of their games that can be viewed with AI analysis. You will also be able to play with a computer model of each of the champions in historical locations, such as the Column Hall of the House of Unions!

3.Two new chess sets, new chess clock (modern digital).

4.Several new characters, in addition to historical ones.

5.Visual improvement of the game process: captured pieces and pawns will be placed on the game table.

6.Improved analysis mode: you can play an alternative variant and then return to the main one.

7.Balance changes: adjusted the play strength of some characters.

8.Accelerated thinking time for characters, especially in the "Modern Tempo" game mode.

9.The design of the main menu and some interface elements has been changed.

10.Fixed several bugs in the system of distributing players to tournaments.

11.Slightly reduced light glare for 3D boards.

12.Other small fixes.

notes.title: Progress Chess: Champions
notes.content:
So, preliminary information about the upcoming major update of the game.

The update will be called Progress Chess: Champions and will contain the following improvements and features:
1.Historical section: a detailed introduction to all world champions starting with Steinitz and an archive of their games! You can view (with AI comments) more than a thousand games of each champion.
2.The ability to play with an digital version of any world champion, created on the basis of the games they played.
3.A more convenient game analysis mode.
4.Improved animation of the game process: captured pieces and pawns are now located on the game table.
5.New locations, including historical ones.
6.New chess players.
7.A new chess set.

All this will become available to players approximately at the end of August - beginning of September this year. A more precise release date for Progress Chess: Champions will be announced later.
